name: digi-theme
description: A Digital World for Claude Code: a pixel Digimon partner above the prompt that digivolves as the context window fills, and a watercolor-sky look with charts, flow graphs, inline images and clickable paths

baby_ii_percent.title: Baby II at (% of context)
baby_ii_percent.description: Context window percentage where the baby reaches its second form. Each stage must be higher than the one before.

rookie_percent.title: Rookie at (% of context)
rookie_percent.description: Context window percentage where the partner becomes a Rookie, such as Agumon. Each stage must be higher than the one before.

champion_percent.title: Champion at (% of context)
champion_percent.description: Context window percentage where the partner becomes a Champion. Each stage must be higher than the one before.

ultimate_percent.title: Ultimate at (% of context)
ultimate_percent.description: Context window percentage where the partner becomes an Ultimate. Each stage must be higher than the one before.

mega_percent.title: Mega at (% of context)
mega_percent.description: Context window percentage where the partner reaches Mega. Each stage must be higher than the one before.
